targeted_public_test_amendments.reason: The original 465-pass receipt remains unchanged and historical. One research-test fixture file was subsequently corrected from assumed 60-second Docker control calls to the frozen helper's actual 30-second calls. Final readiness detected its changed hash and refused completion. This exact file was then rerun from the clean public src-layout stage: 34 tests passed, with identical pre/post source hashes. All other original 53 tested files, including every runtime file, remain exact; this is a targeted retest, not a new 465-test execution.
